blocks.value: This certificate is issued for formal documentation of fire door compliance within the
above-listed premises. It is intended for inclusion in the property’s fire safety
management system and may be used as evidence in support of: Insurance policy
requirements and Fire risk assessments and legal audits.
Types of Doors: 80 x Flat Entrance FD30
Standards Referenced: BS 889 Part 12, BS 8214:2016, BS 9538:2017
Senior Fire Door Inspector – FIA Certified
